faq.q: What is the origin of Hafizh?
faq.a: Hafizh is associated with Arabic. Hafizh is a spelling variant of Arabic حفيظ (Ḥafīẓ) 'guardian, preserver'. The source gloss 'memory keeper, memorizer' reflects the ḥāfiẓ title; the lexical sense is 'guardian'.
Yes — the underlying form حفيظ is Arabic.

faq.q: What does Hafizh mean in Persian?

faq.a: Romanization variants include Hafizh, hafizh. Script forms are حفيظ, حفیظ, हफ़ीज़.

faq.q: Is Hafizh a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
